objectives: Explain food allergies and dietary needs clearly
Use don't/doesn't and can't to say what you cannot eat

grammar.explanation: To describe dietary needs, use the present simple negative: "I don't eat meat" and "She doesn't drink milk". Use can't or cannot for things you must avoid: "I can't eat gluten". To say you have an allergy, say "I am allergic to ..." and then name the food.
grammar.explanationAr: لوصف الاحتياجات الغذائية نستخدم النفي في المضارع البسيط مثل: I don't eat meat و She doesn't drink milk. ونستخدم can't أو cannot لما يجب تجنبه مثل: I can't eat gluten. ولبيان وجود حساسية قل I am allergic to ... ثم اسم الطعام.

examples.en: I don't eat meat, but I eat fish.
examples.ar: لا آكل اللحم، لكنني آكل السمك.

vocabulary.example: Peanut oil is common in kitchens.
